GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Four Wide 7th 4 Lengths 800m 3 Wide 2nd last 5 Lengths home turn Hooked Out 3 Wide 7th Middle Of Track only held position Straight # back/weak late
Jumped okay then tightened & checked, Settled Down 7.5 Lengths on fence, Moved Up to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted wider Straightening Up and Made Some Ground to the line # Checked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Checked when tightened between runners shortly after the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down on fence behind the leader trailing 2.5 lengths, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, hugged fence turning, Held Up straightening untiltaking cutaway, railed to lead at 250m, kept going and only Headed 30m or So from the line # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: At the entrance to the straight became held up on heels and was unable to improve until near the 350m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: Option to be further forward; Settled off midfield. Rdr reported she was instructed that she had the option to ride the gelding further forward if it began well. She added that after her mnt began only fairly and failed to muster speed in the early stages, she restrained her mount to obtain a position with cover at the rear of the field. Passing the 350m had to be checked when crowded between runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Not Bustled settled down third last Two Wide between rivals 6 Lengths (800m), travelled well before asked to go 450, brought widest for home work to do, going after leader late kept coming right to the line # just missed!
Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, headed Straightening Up and dropped out # led/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear own terms to Straightening Up challenged x 1st @ 400m, dueled to 100m, Couldn'T Go On had its chance - # battled final 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported soon after the start her saddle shifted back, placing her at a disadvantage, and for this reason she allowed the mare to roll forward, whereby it obtained the lead after passing the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, pushed along a touch turn, joint lead Straightening Up , took over 200m drew 1 length clear b4 headed passing 100m, kept on well late # no match 1,2
Jumped Well drifted back 6l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on fairly # disappointing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Overraced in the early and middle stages. Near 1200m when overracing shifted out and hampered a rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 6th, 5 Lengths @ 800m. Ridden Along Straightening Up all Clear . Every Chance in Straight Never Stopped Trying drove to line, Just missed # had chance/almost
Jumped Ok drifted back to last 6l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well making good ground # back/ran on well
